test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 04 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which among the following dance form was originally performed in the temples of Tamil Nadu, by the Devadasis and therefore it is also known as Dasiattam?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatnatyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bharatnatyam**

 
 
• Bharatanatyam of Tamil Nadu in Southern India has grown out of the art of dancers dedicated to temples and was earlier known as Sadir or Dasi Attam.
 
• It is the first of India's traditional dances to be refashioned by theatre artists and to be exhibited widely both at home and abroad.
